go.name: Go runtime and standard library
go.basis: Every libhost.a contains Go runtime and standard-library code; Blueprint.lock selects the reviewed Go distribution.

musl.name: musl libc with Zig patches
musl.basis: Linux targets contain startup objects and static musl inputs from the locked linker-input release.

zig-runtime.name: Zig libc and compiler runtime
zig-runtime.basis: Linux and Windows targets contain Zig runtime libraries from the locked linker-input release.

mingw.name: mingw-w64 startup and Windows import metadata
mingw.basis: Windows targets contain MinGW startup and import inputs; their per-file license exceptions are in the distributed COPYING notice.

darwin.name: Project-authored Darwin libSystem interface metadata
darwin.basis: The Darwin targets use project-generated interface metadata. No Apple runtime or SDK implementation is redistributed.
